abilities.name: Fury
abilities.description: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.; trait

fields.notes: Sonya starts at 0 Fury when she respawns. Basic Attacks generate 6 Fury each and every instance of damage Sonya takes generates 2 Fury. Movement Speed bonus does not stack, but instead refreshes the duration.

abilities.name: Ancient Spear
abilities.description: Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173 damage and briefly Stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch
fields.notes: Ancient Spear can be used while Rooted, damaging the enemy and stunning them upon hit, but it will not cause Sonya to be pulled to them. Ancient Spear 's Stun has variable duration and lasts until Sonya reaches her target (5 server ticks, or .3125s, at max range. 1 server tick, or .0625s, at point blank.) If the enemy dies from the impact or while Sonya is being pulled to them, the pull will continue until Sonya reaches their location. Hitting an enemy with Ancient Spear will reset Sonya's Basic Attack cooldown.

abilities.name: Seismic Slam
abilities.description: Deals 176 damage to the target enemy and 44 to enemies behind the target.

fields.notes: 1) Splash search is done in three 3x2 areas, impacting at 0.15 intervals behind the target. The first search takes place at the same time as the initial impact. Primary target cannot be hit by the splash damage of the same cast.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Deals 138 damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.; 5 / 0.75

fields.props: Area of Effect, Lifesteal, Mobile channel
fields.notes: Really averages 161 DPS over 3 seconds, because there are 7 ticks including one immediately and one at the end of the 3 seconds. Whirlwind can be reactivated after 0.75 seconds to end its effect early. Lifesteal value against Heroes is set to 75% of damage dealt. Sonya ignores collision with Heroes, Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters while Whirlwinding. While Whirlwinding, Sonya attempts to closely follow behind the target of the last attack command issued to her.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 damage to nearby enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.; 60; heroic

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Launch, Status Effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Stun, Unstoppable
fields.notes: 1) Extended by Sonya's unit radius. Sonya becomes Unstoppable while in the air. Targeting Leap less than 0.65 units from Sonya's location causes her to land in place after 0.2 seconds' delay. Regardless, Leap is a Movement Ability and cannot be cast while Rooted.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Berserker
abilities.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against you by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.; 60; heroic

fields.type: Offensive damage modifier, Crowd control reduction
fields.notes: Cooldown starts when the Ability is cast. Does not stack with itself. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Sonya's damage output.

talents.name: Furious Blow
talents.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Seismic Slam 's primary damage.

_raw_fields: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

talents.name: Tough As Nails
talents.description: Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%. Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Physical Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

talents.name: Shattered Ground
talents.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies instead increases the length of Seismic Slam's splash by 66%.

fields.notes: Damage bonuses stack additively with themselves and any other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Seismic Slam 's splash damage. This value is still separate from the primary damage and does not benefit from damage modifiers that only affect the primary damage.
